meta: Toilet shut-off valve stuck, dripping or won't close? Learn the fix, the supply line swap and when to call a plumber in Oakley, CA. Call (888) 910-8644.
lead: A toilet shut-off valve repair in Oakley, CA usually means freeing a stuck stop, tightening a weeping stem or replacing the valve and its supply line. Many are a short job once the water is off.
intro: The toilet shut-off valve, also called an angle stop or supply stop, is the small oval or round handle on the wall or floor behind the bowl. It lets you cut water to one toilet without closing the whole house, which is exactly what you need when a fill valve fails or a repair is due.

When that valve will not turn, drips from its stem or leaks at the line, the repair path depends on what is wrong. This guide helps Oakley, CA homeowners sort out the cause, decide what is safe to try, and know when a plumber should take over.

sections.h2: Four ways a toilet stop valve fails

items.d: Mineral scale and years without use leave the stem stuck. Forcing it can snap the handle or twist the valve body and crack the pipe behind the wall.
A slow weep behind the handle usually points at a worn packing nut or washer. A small turn of the packing nut may stop it, but a valve that keeps seeping needs replacing.
Wet fittings at either end of the braided hose mean a loose nut or a tired washer. These lines are cheap to swap, and a leaking one should not be left to drip into the subfloor.
If water still trickles into the tank when the handle is closed, the valve seat inside is worn. The valve has to be replaced, since cleaning rarely restores a bad seat.

sections.h2: Safe first steps before anything gets wet
paras: Start by flushing the toilet once, then try closing the stop by hand with a gentle clockwise turn. Do not use pliers on a stuck handle. If it moves, you have a working valve and can proceed with the toilet repair or line swap you planned.

If it will not budge, leave it alone and use the house main instead. Once the water is off, hold a towel under the supply line, loosen the nut with a wrench, and see whether the fitting is dry. Photos of the valve before you touch it help a plumber judge what to bring. Fixture shutoffs are part of what the California Plumbing Code, which tracks the UPC, expects at every toilet.
bullets: Flush once and mop the tank so you can see any new drip
Place a towel and a small bowl under the fittings
Take a photo of the valve and line before disconnecting
Note whether the pipe comes out of the wall or the floor

sections.h2: Repair, replace the line, or replace the whole valve
paras: The choice follows the symptom. Parts are inexpensive, so the real cost is the time and the risk of damage if a stuck valve breaks. A plumber handling [[toilet-repair|toilet repair]] can do the valve at the same visit, which saves a second shutoff of the house.

paras: Older multi-turn stops wear out because the rubber washer is squeezed against a seat each time the handle closes. A quarter-turn ball valve moves through a short arc and is less likely to seize. If your valve needs replacing, ask for a quarter-turn model, and add a new braided stainless line while the water is off.

The same logic applies to other fixtures: if you are replacing a stop here, check the ones under the bathroom sink at the same time. Our [[faucet-repair|faucet repair]] page covers sink stops and supply lines, and most plumbers will swap several in one visit.

sections.h2: When the valve will not close and water is running
paras: If water is pouring and the stop will not turn, shut the whole house off at the main. Open the lowest faucet afterward to relieve pressure, then call a plumber. Do not keep wrestling a valve that is spraying, because a cracked body can empty the supply line onto your floor.

Mop what you can, move rugs, and photograph any wet drywall or flooring for your insurer. Water in a wall cavity can spread unseen, so a damp baseboard is worth a plumber's moisture check even after the flow stops.

localnote.h2: Why the main shutoff matters in Oakley
paras: Diablo Water District supplies Oakley, and its pipe reaches only as far as your meter and backflow device. Everything past the meter belongs to the owner, including the house shutoff, the pipes and every stop valve behind a toilet. If your toilet valve fails and the house main also sticks, the meter valve may be your last way to stop the water.

Find the meter box and the main shutoff now, before you need them, and note that Diablo Water District can confirm which pipes are its own at your property. Their water emergency line is (925) 625-3798. We serve homes across the [[service-area|service area]] around Oakley, and the same shutoff habit helps owners in [[plumber-brentwood-ca|Brentwood]], where the City of Brentwood runs its own water system.

faqs.q: Can I replace a toilet shut-off valve myself?
a: Many owners can, when the valve turns and the house water can be shut off. It takes a wrench, a new valve and line, and some care with the compression fitting.
A frozen valve or a crumbling pipe stub behind the wall is a different job, and forcing it risks a bigger leak.

faqs.q: Why does my toilet valve drip only when I turn it?
a: The stem packing is worn. Turning the handle pulls the packing across the stem and lets a little water past.
A small quarter turn of the packing nut can help. If the drip comes back, replace the valve.

faqs.q: How often should I replace the braided supply line?
a: There is no single clock, but a line that is kinked, bulging, rusty at the nut or sweating wet should go. Replacing it whenever the toilet is already being worked on is cheap insurance.
Check the line when you clean behind the toilet.

faqs.q: Should I shut off the whole house for a toilet repair?
a: Only when the toilet stop will not close. A working stop isolates the toilet, so the rest of the house keeps water.
Test the stop before starting by closing it, flushing and watching whether the tank refills.

faqs.q: Where is the water meter shutoff for my Oakley home?
a: The meter sits in a ground-level box near the street, usually in the front. Diablo Water District is responsible up to the meter, and the owner is responsible past it.
Ask the district to confirm where its line ends at your property, and learn your house main as well.

cta_mid: A stop valve that will not turn is easy to break. Have it replaced with the house water off and no surprise leaks.
cta_end: Get the stuck valve and tired supply line replaced in one visit, with a clear price before work starts.
